source_evidence.text: | **Spot** | 1 AP | Make an **INT Check** or **SPI Check** against **12**, whichever is higher, to reveal one eligible **Hidden** enemy combatant. |

**Spot:** A universal action. Choose one **Hidden** enemy within **12"** and **LOS**. **Spot** may choose a **Hidden** combatant despite the targeting restriction in **5.9**. Make an **INT Check** or **SPI Check** against **12**, whichever is higher, with **Disadvantage** if that enemy has **Cover**. records.title: Fifteen enhanced-table values differ from the quality formula
decisions: Remove developmental value multipliers from material/craftsmanship traits; preserve their effects.
Owner-selected fixed prices govern; remove the pricing formula and example. Unpriced granted qualities retain the existing value rather than generating a new price.

source_evidence.text:
#### Material and Craftsmanship Traits

| Trait | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| **Adamantine** | Attacks with this weapon ignore up to **2 AV**. |
| **Cold Iron** | Attacks with this weapon against a **Fey** ignore up to **2 AV** and deal an additional **2 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |
| **Elven** | Reduce this weapon's **DEX requirement** by **1**. If this would reduce the requirement below **1**, the weapon has no **DEX Req**. This weapon does not count as metal for the restrictions in **8.2**. |
| **Sacred** | Attacks with this weapon against a **Fiend** deal an additional **1d4 holy damage**. |
| **Masterwork** | Once per round, reroll one retained natural **1** rolled by this item's base damage dice, or one natural **1** rolled by this item's **AD** or a **Check** its rule requires. Resolve this reroll before determining **Total Miss** or **Critical Hit**, and use the new result. |
| **Palesteel** | Reduce this weapon's **STR requirement** by **1**. If this would reduce the requirement below **1**, the weapon has no **STR Req**. |
| **Silvered** | Attacks with this weapon against a **Lycanthrope** ignore up to **2 AV** and deal an additional **2 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |

Use the **Cost (c)** or **Value (c)** printed for the finished item. Item Qualities do not calculate a price. If a rule grants a quality to an item with no listed enhanced value, retain its value before the quality was granted. An enhanced item with no listed finished value cannot be purchased, commissioned, or upgraded unless a rule supplies its price. Treasure tables grant the finished item they list.

#### Weapon Qualities

Weapon qualities that share a name with a weapon trait grant that exact trait from **Section 7.7**.

| Quality | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| **Masterwork** | This weapon gains the **Masterwork** trait. |
| **Silvered** | This weapon gains the **Silvered** trait. |
| **Cold Iron** | This weapon gains the **Cold Iron** trait. |
| **Elven** | This weapon gains the **Elven** trait. |
| **Sacred** | This weapon gains the **Sacred** trait. |
| **Palesteel** | This weapon gains the **Palesteel** trait. |
| **Adamantine** | This weapon gains the **Adamantine** trait. |
| Enchanted +1 | This weapon deals an additional **1 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |
| Enchanted +2 | This weapon deals an additional **2 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |
| Enchanted +3 | This weapon deals an additional **3 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |
| Enchanted +4 | This weapon deals an additional **4 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |
| Enchanted +5 | This weapon deals an additional **5 damage of that attack's primary damage type**. |

#### Armour and Shield Qualities

A shield cannot take an **Enchanted +X** quality. Use the named shields in **Special Armour and Shields** in **7.17** instead.

| Quality | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| **Masterwork** | **Chest or Shield:** Once per round, reroll one natural **1** when rolling this item's **AD**. A flat-AV shield instead gains **+1 AV** for one **Block** that round. |
| **Silvered** | **Chest or Shield:** After a non-**Total Miss** melee attack made by a **Lycanthrope** against you resolves, the attacker suffers **1d6 holy damage**. |
| **Cold Iron** | **Chest or Shield:** After a non-**Total Miss** melee attack made by a **Fey** against you resolves, the attacker suffers **1d6 fire damage**. |
| **Elven** | **Metal only. Chest:** This item does not count as metal for the restrictions in **8.2**. |
| **Sacred** | **Chest:** Add **+2** to **AD** rolls against attacks made by **Undead**, **Fiends**, and **Cursed** combatants. The wearer cannot become **Cursed**. **Shield:** Gain **+2 AV** when using **Block** against those attackers. |
| **Palesteel** | **Metal only. Chest or Shield:** Reduce this item's **STR requirement** by **1**. If this would reduce the requirement below **1**, the item has no **STR Req**. |
| Enchanted +1 | **Chest only:** Add **+1** to **AD** rolls. |
| Enchanted +2 | **Chest only:** Add **+2** to **AD** rolls. |
| Enchanted +3 | **Chest only:** Add **+3** to **AD** rolls. |
| Enchanted +4 | **Chest only:** Add **+4** to **AD** rolls. |
| Enchanted +5 | **Chest only:** Add **+5** to **AD** rolls. |
| **Adamantine** | **Metal only. Chest:** Add **+2** to **AD** rolls. When this item's **AD** is rolled against an attack, that attack cannot deal **Critical Hit** bonus damage or trigger **Critical Hit** effects against you. **Metal only. Shield:** Gain **+2 AV** when using **Block**. An attack modified by this **Block** cannot deal **Critical Hit** bonus damage or trigger **Critical Hit** effects against you. |
| **Item value** | Use the finished item's printed **Cost (c)** or **Value (c)**. A granted quality with no listed enhanced value leaves the item's existing value unchanged. |

- **Sale value:** Unless a rule says otherwise, an item's base value is its listed finished **Cost (c)** or **Value (c)**. It sells for **50%** of its base value. Round the sale value down to the nearest **1c**, minimum **0c**. An item with a final sale value below **1c** sells for **0c**.

- **Masterwork Upgrade [1 TAP]:** Upgrade up to **2** mundane weapons, Chest armour pieces, or shields that do not already have an Item Quality and have a listed Masterwork value in **7.11**. Each upgraded item gains the **Masterwork** quality. Cost: pay the difference between the item's base value and its Masterwork value, minimum **1c**, per item upgraded. When sold, an item upgraded this way uses its value before the upgrade.

source_evidence.text: **Traps:** Each **Satchel** and the **Strongbox** is potentially trapped. During setup, prepare **4** face-down tokens for the default scenario: **1** marked **"Trap"** and **3** blank. If the **Advanced Ogre** variant is used, prepare **5** face-down tokens instead: **2** marked **"Trap"** and **3** blank. Place one token under each treasure marker without revealing it. **Hidden Strongbox:** Place **3 Strongbox** markers along the battlefield midline, each within **6"** of at least one other Strongbox marker. Only one is real.

- **Interact [1 AP], Identify:** A combatant adjacent to an unidentified Strongbox marker and not **Engaged** makes an **INT Check**. On a success, that marker is the real **Strongbox** and may be picked up by the same **Interact**. On a failure, remove that marker as a fake. After **2** fakes are removed, the remaining marker is real and needs no Check.
- When the real Strongbox is identified, remove all other Strongbox markers. Remove each fake's trap token, if any, without revealing it.
- An unidentified Strongbox cannot be picked up. Resolve identification before any pickup-triggered trap. If a trap prevents pickup, the identified Strongbox remains real; later pickup needs no identification Check. Trap inspection and removal do not identify a Strongbox.

source_evidence.text:
#### 10.5.4 PvE Initiative

At the start of each round in **solo** and **cooperative** play, one allied player rolls **1d20**, adding bonuses granted to the party's Initiative roll. Do not add a Party Leader's **INT** or **SPI**.

- **Total 12 or higher:** The Heroes seize the initiative. Resolve the **Party Phase**, then the **Monster Phase**.
- **Total 11 or lower:** The wilderness strikes. Resolve the **Monster Phase**, then the **Party Phase**.

This roll replaces competitive side-based Initiative in PvE play. The rolled phase order also sets simultaneous-effect priority under **3.6 Timing Rules**.

After both phases have resolved, proceed to the **End of Round**.

source_evidence.text: *A Ranger targets a **Large** Monster with a **2×2-square** footprint in Grid Mode. Under **2.6**, test source-square and target-square pairs using one pair for range, **LOS**, and **Cover**. One pair has a sight line that touches the corner of a **Cover Terrain** square but does not pass through that square's interior and crosses no **Blocking Terrain**. That pair has **LOS**, and the touched terrain grants **Cover**. If another legal pair gives the target less Cover, use that pair instead; if Cover is tied, use the shortest range. If every possible pair is blocked by **Blocking Terrain**, a solid floor/roof/platform, or the interior of an intervening **Cover Terrain** square as described in **2.7.2**, the Ranger has no **LOS**.*

6. **Place Terrain, Objectives, Hazards, and Extraction Zones.** Resolve their setup rules before placing Monsters that depend on them.
7. **Deploy All Monster Groups.** Place every group. Random Monster Groups begin **Resting** unless a scenario-specific setup rule says otherwise.
8. **Apply Scenario-Specific Waking Rules.** If the scenario says that one or more groups begin **Awake**, follow that scenario's instructions. If the scenario says to determine Awake groups randomly, randomly choose from among all legally deployed groups.

*Example, Solo Setup:* *Marta begins a solo campaign with three Heroes at **APL 2**. They choose **The Mire** as the Climate, roll a Core Scenario within that Climate, then roll one swamp Secondary Objective and one swamp Weather result. Because three Heroes are in play, the adventure uses **4** Random Monster Groups. After placing the terrain, objectives, hazards, and extraction zones, Marta deploys all four groups according to the scenario's Random Monster Setup. Each group begins **Resting** unless the scenario gives a specific waking rule. Only after all Monsters, hazards, and objectives are placed does Marta deploy their Heroes and begin Round 1.*
